ValidationRule.description: Blocks New York concerts scheduled in December through February when the venue is closed for winter
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(City__c, "New York"), OR( MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 12, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 1, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 2 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New York concerts cannot be scheduled from December through February because the venue is closed for winter.
